title: Heart of Nature
journal_entries: The priest told me of a terrible blight afflicting the states of High Rock, one that is laying low scores of peasants and young. He thinks he can come up with a solution to the plague by using the hearts of Spriggan with alchemy to create some immunity. My first target is one of the smaller Spriggans.
The sap from the lesser spriggan is with me, now to look for the Spriggan Matron and head back to the priest.
I have the saps within my possession, I must consort with the priest yet again for him to develop a remedy.
objectives: Collect 2 samples of Lesser Spriggan Sap (<Global=ArnimaSprigLessCount>/<Global=ArnimaSprigLessTotal>)
Take Sap from the Spriggan Matron
Bring the Sap back to the Priest

title: Of Roaches and Rats
journal_entries: Elritch told me of an altercation between two beggars that resulted in one being executed while the other sought security among the guard by being their informant. Fortunately they seemed to not have let slip anything vital to the rat as he hasn't been dealt with immediately. He's locked himself up within the jail of Arnima, the place that I'll be delving into.
It didn't take much effort to deal with the snitch, and the helmet is now mine. I will make for Elritch once again to inform him of the deed, with the proof.
objectives: Kill the snitch and retrieve the helmet
Bring the Helmet back to Elritch

Plight of the Plagued
journal_entries: Horustair asked me to accompany him, and aid him in an investigation on the blighted village of Azra's Crossing. He told me to meet him at the bridge connecting the village to the Kingdom.
I should follow Horustair towards the village.

The woman sounded hysterical, it seems the villagers don't want us poking around inside the village. But alas, I am a knight, and need to attend to this duty lest my name be slandered. I will head into the mines and see if there is something of interest inside.
objectives: Go back and tell Horustair about the ordeal

title: Killing the Cynic
journal_entries: The camp's sole Shaman; Arami, has tasked me in retrieving a Luna Moth Wing for her concoction. We hope that the resultant brew could be used to turn Denize partially invisible so that she can escape. However, it isn't certain whether that potion will have its intended effect - it all depends on Arami's word.

Arami stirred and extracted strange liquid which I now possess, in this small flask that can either spell that captive Breton's death or salvation. I should go with haste as to not waste the distraction Arami has provided.

Denize ultimately succumbed to my words, knowing that the dilemma was a false one as either outcome had her fate in our hands. She smelt a possibility to regain her own agency and lunged for it, I now act as her escort so that she can be free from her chains.
objectives: Attain a Luna Moth Wing and bring it to Arami
[Optional] Search the marshes at night for a Luna Moth
Escort Denize out of the Camps
Return to Arami and tell her of Denize's death

title: Forever Evermore
journal_entries: The defender of the gate to Evermore told me of a rogue guard who slipped away from duty when he was seen bearing the mark of the afflicted. I will need to speak to him and inquire about what he plans to do with his pestilent crew.

Mortierre told me of the situation regarding the afflicted, saying that they're in desperate need of health potions. I think that these potions may negate the progress of aging, so the disease doesn't claim their lives totally. I will bring back 3 potions in exchange for information.
objectives: Use the Magelight spell to alert the guards if you're in trouble
Bring 3 Minor Health Potions for the Afflicted (Or head back to the gate guard for the potions)
Confirm to Mortierre that the immediate threat has been dealt with
Return and inform the gate guard of the death

journal_entries: My trek up this crag was halted by an injured Breton scout, bearing the mark of Evermore. Through strained breath, he spoke of a deranged Orc Shaman at the peak of this rock - one who is directing the dead ever outwards. If I'm to tackle this danger, I should beware the magic that she will undoubtedly use against me.
objectives: Kill the deranged Shaman or calm her down
